mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 67 degrees with moderate rain expected near the Verona Public Library. Also, keep an eye on the sky tonight at 7:36 PM for a visible pass of the International Space Station, which will rise in the west over Mount Horeb and head northeast toward Madison near the Home Depot, reaching halfway up the sky while the moon is in a waxing crescent phase.

The Verona Police Department released a summary of notable service calls from August 31 through September 14. Reported incidents included a domestic battery on August 31, a bail jumping arrest on September 2, an O W I crash on September 3, and a high-speed traffic stop on September 5. More serious events included a sexual assault investigation on September 4 and a burglary on September 10 where a suspect was apprehended.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Today, join in for Hop Haus Trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co or Quizmasters Trivia at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company, or trivia at The Bogey Factory.

In a noteworthy update, on September 5, officers responded to reports of vehicles with slices of cheese on their windshields, confirming it was part of a viral social media prank known as the Dairy Dare.
Culver's is currently closed for a remodel, but the store opens today at 10:00 AM, where you can enjoy today's flavor of the day.
